o.text: From Proto-Turkic *yïm-ĺča-k (“soft, mild”). Cognate with Old Turkic 𐰘𐰢𐱁𐰴 (yïmšaq), Turkish yumuşak, Crimean Tatar yımşaq, yumşaq, etc.
Ultimately a derivation of Proto-Turkic *tüt(e)- (“smoke, to smoke”), whence also Azerbaijani tüstü (“smoke”).
From Proto-Turkic *kus- (“to vomit”). Cognate with Turkish kusmak, Chuvash хӑсак (hăs̬ak, “vomit, spew”, noun), etc.
From Persian خزینهدار. By surface analysis, xəzinə + -dar.
